\[
\text{Excluded} = \lfloor \sqrt{N} \rfloor + \lfloor N^{1/3} \rfloor - \lfloor N^{1/6} \rfloor
\]

The count of numbers in the sequence up to \( N \) is then:

\[
N - \left( \lfloor \sqrt{N} \rfloor + \lfloor N^{1/3} \rfloor - \lfloor N^{1/6} \rfloor \right)
\]
